verification_notes: Core bow/ammo/crossbow Fletching levels below are from official Patch Notes: Mid-Game Rebalance (20 Jul 2026), not pre-rebalance wiki training tables.

Wiki Pay-to-play Fletching training and Ironman Mode/Guide/Fletching are both bannered outdated for the re-tier — use them only for infrastructure, shops, and Accidental F&F geography, never for pre-rebalance level gates as truth.

Only official mid-band XP/h numbers published for this skill post-rebalance are primal arrows 900k and primal bolts 975k (scraped into midgame-rebalance-2026-07-20.json from the rebalance dataset). Mid-ladder bow/ammo XP/h is intentionally omitted rather than invented.
Darts, knives and javelins were explicitly not re-tiered; any dart ladder from stale wiki is out of scope for this core rebalance ladder.

methods.notes: Confirmed NEW shortbow Fletching: short 1, oak 10, willow 20, maple 40, acadia 50, yew 70, magic 80, elder 90, eternal magic 100. NEW longbow: long 5, oak 15, willow 25, maple 45, acadia 55, yew 75, magic 85, elder 95, eternal magic 105 (+5 Fletching vs same-tier shortbow). NEW arrows: bronze 1, iron 10, steel 20, mithril 30, adamant 40, rune 50, broad 52 (unchanged), orikalkum 60, necronium 70, bane 80, elder rune 90, primal 100. NEW bolts: bronze 3, iron 13, steel 23, mithril 33, adamant 43, rune 53, orikalkum 63, necronium 73, bane 83, elder rune 93, primal 103. Shieldbows retired into longbows (+1 attack range). Acadia fills tier-50 bow gap; yew/magic now 70/80 Ranged (members-only). Crossbow stocks re-aligned to Woodcutting tier (e.g. mithril uses teak stock). Primal bolts unified: 50 unf per bar then feathered. Bane ammo: Tune Bane Ore on finished bane arrows/bolts. Bolt/arrow proficiency benefits removed; first-unlock XP baseline raised. Path: shafts/headless -> re-tiered bows by wood band -> matching ammo -> orikalkum/necronium/bane/elder -> eternal magic/primal end band.
methods.warning: Do not use pre-20-Jul maple/yew/magic Fletching gates or pre-rebalance wiki 1-99 tables as truth. Per-action XP values on wiki bow/ammo rows may still lag the rebalance XP rebalance — recheck item pages before optimizer use.

methods.level_range: Any Fletching once room built; Construction 50 (T1) / 65 (T2) / 80 (T3)

methods.location: Ranger's Workroom, Fort Forinthry (built during Dead and Buried progress)
methods.notes: Region dual-note: physical building is Fort Forinthry (south-eastern Wilderness edge). Catalyst League historically filed Fort under Misthalin; planner may treat Fort+Raptor as Forinthry-adjacent. Keep dual-label until Equilibrium hard boundary. T1: 2% resource save on various weapons/ammo, 1% extra shaft bundle, bank chest, spinning wheel, fletching workbench, ranged target. T2: 1% extra ranged ammo/headless shafts (full XP on extras), 2% chance strung bows when fletching unstrung. T3: +5% base Fletching XP in room (multiplies with other XP boosts), Wisdom of Anima toggle on workbench (dinarrow imbue efficient, low XP). Bonuses apply while standing in room. Common setup: bank chest + portable fletcher inside room (W84 GE also common for mains).
methods.warning: Workroom does not replace materials; it only buffs save/XP while training other methods. Construction and fort quest progress are separate gates.

methods.xp_rate: ~225,515 Fletching XP/h wiki (196.1 XP per action, Fletching-only configure); ~200k+ still cited on ironman guide as AFK free alternative

methods.notes: Configure cuticles for Fletching XP only (cut), Firemaking only (dry), or alternate. Outputs 12-15 tempered fungal shafts per action. Crystal knife: 5% double shafts + XP when earning Fletching XP; does not degrade while carestyling. Shafts spin 5:1 into stackable fungal bowstring (stringing support without flax loops). Still valid post-rebalance; rebalance did not touch Accidental F&F. Related pipeline (not this method): Seggregation 87 FM -> sharp shell shards; Eggsperimentation 95 FM -> dinosaur 'propellant'; construct dinarrows at 95 Fletching.
methods.warning: Requires Extinction and Anachronia access. XP/h assumes Fletching-only configure and accounts for zygomite travel downtime on wiki; not a banked-ammo peak rate.

methods.method: Material source — primal bars / orikalkum-necronium-bane-elder metals

methods.notes: Rebalance cut Smithing XP on arrowheads and unfinished bolts hard (−27.5% iron scaling to −50% primal) so ironman head production is a larger Smithing tax per Fletching XP hour. Primal bolts: 50 unf per bar then feathers. Orikalkum/necronium/bane/elder rune ammo fill 60–90 bands. Bane: smith bane arrows/bolts then Tune Bane Ore for specialty (ironman effective gate higher than old 76 path).
methods.warning: Do not budget pre-rebalance Smithing XP-from-ammo rates. Primal is a hard Forinthry mining gate for self-source.

methods.notes: Still valid T95 arrow path. Recipe: 15 tempered fungal shafts + 15 dinosaur 'propellant' -> 15 headless dinarrows; +15 sharp shell shards -> 15 dinarrows. Components exclusive to Accidental F&F activities (or trade for mains). Portable fletcher can save materials; Ranger's Workroom can grant extra product. Imbue with resonant anima into Bik/Ful/Wen/Jas dragonbane/Jas demonbane (Tune Bane Ore still works on dinarrows for Jas demonbane per patch notes). Workroom T3 Wisdom of Anima: imbue dinarrows efficiently but awards little XP — combat ammo path, not training.
methods.warning: Dinarrows are combat/self-ammo progression, not a substitute for official primal 900k/975k training rates. Mid-game rebalance did not delete dinarrows; it only reaffirmed Tune Bane Ore on dinarrows for Jas demonbane.
